case_title: FOELL, KURT WERNER VS CHERNISS, IRENE

docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $7,500.00 FILED BY FOELL, KURT WERNER AS TO DEFENDANT CHERNISS, IRENE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR NOV-06-2007 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
CERTIFIED MAIL RECEIPT RETURNED SIGNED SENT TO IRENE CHERNISS DEFENDANT.
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-06-2007 - JUDGMENT. COMMISSIONER PAUL SLAVIT, CLERK FANNY RAYRAY, NOT REPORTED. (506).

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF FOELL, KURT WERNER RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT CHERNISS, IRENE $1,625.00 PRINCIPAL, $85.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,710.00, BASED ONLY ON PLAINTIFF'S TESTIMONY, WITHOUT RECORDS OF MEDICAL EXPENSES, DETERMINED PLAINTIFF'S DAMAGES TO BE $2500.00 AND ATTRIBUTES 35% COMPARATIVE FAULT TO PLAINTIFF.THE JUDGMENT IS A NET AWARD. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT CHERNISS, IRENE
NOTICE OF ENTRY OF JUDGMENT RETURNED SENT TO DEFT.
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED FEB-01-2008 ORDERED DESTROYED
